caller_asset_contract.notes: Every vendor runtime file, licence entitlement, configuration, corpus manifest, processed-output manifest, DNSMOS-C checkpoint, scoring environment lock, rights record and redistribution approval must exist at an absolute path and match its declared SHA-256 before a caller may score outputs. The scope is vendor-output scoring, not live vendor runtime processing in the default package. No vendor runtime version is pinned because no licensed runtime or SDK terms are recorded.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply the licensed Krisp Voice Isolation 2.5 SDK runtime, its exact version/build identity and per-file SHA-256 manifest; no vendor runtime, library, model or entitlement is present.
Record the exact commercial entitlement and vendor terms for local processing, output retention, scoring, publication and redistribution; no licence text, grant or entitlement exists.
Document the vendor SDK ABI, callback contract, supported sample rate, channel count, frame size, content delay, reset and drain behaviour before any isolated adapter may be built.

Supply the official DNSMOS-C/NISQA checkpoint at runs/NISQA/model_best.pt, its feature extractor and the exact windowing configuration with byte counts and SHA-256 values; no checkpoint or scorer code is present.
Provide an isolated hash-pinned offline Python runtime at data/envs/dnsmos-c/requirements.lock with a recorded platform; no scoring environment, package lock or interpreter pin exists.

Supply the 265-file Krisp-AI/VoiceIsolation-Benchmark-Dataset at revision 626bac8ca07fb9b4846d4f62d27c321753160b36 with a per-file SHA-256 manifest and the CC BY-NC 4.0 terms; only the revision is recorded and no audio is retained.

Supply the vi_2_5_default subset of Krisp-AI/VoiceIsolation-Benchmark-Dataset-Processed at revision 8759715197e39e0356125e3f3197a9854c38fa60 (265 files, 647,960,782 bytes) with a per-file manifest; no output is retained or identified by digest.
Clear noncommercial corpus use, vendor-output retention, scoring, publication and any redistribution with complete notices; no rights approval or output-use grant exists.
Freeze the exact 265-file list, scenario mapping, segment windowing, failed-item policy, aggregation and one approved vendor parity vector; no comparison manifest or parity result exists.

Reproduce or explicitly defer the 11-configuration WER ensemble with its transcripts, ASR hypotheses and NeMo WFST normalization; one local ASR engine cannot reproduce the vendor aggregate, so WER remains not measured.

external_profile_requirements.requirement: Document the allowed access and the exact candidate or processed data.
Separate local runtime, vendor-output scoring and vendor claim.
Verify what fallback and disclosure are possible without a licensed runtime, code or asset in the default package.

gates.requirement: The licensed vendor runtime version, build, per-file SHA-256 manifest, entitlement and terms match exact pins.
An isolated, hash-pinned vendor runtime and scoring environment are admitted on a recorded platform.
Corpus, transcript, vendor-output, scoring, publication and redistribution rights are cleared with complete notices.
One approved vendor-output file matches an approved exact-runtime reference for one frozen Voice Isolation 2.5 configuration.
The pinned DNSMOS-C scorer reproduces the scenario-balanced comparison on the frozen 265-file output set with recorded failures.
Local runtime, vendor-output scoring and vendor claims stay separate, and no source-reported value is presented as reproduced.
Explicit opt-in vendor adapter intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision are complete.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

licensing.source_asset_license: unverified; the vendor runtime and SDK terms are absent and the public corpus is CC BY-NC 4.0 with no local copy

qualification.reason: The licensed Krisp Voice Isolation 2.5 runtime, entitlement and SDK terms are absent, as are the DNSMOS-C/NISQA checkpoint and scoring runtime, the CC BY-NC 4.0 corpus, the 265 processed vendor outputs, rights approval, comparison manifest and parity vector; the 11-engine WER ensemble is unrun and all vendor numbers remain source-reported.

reproduction.comparison: canonical JSON bytes, SHA-256 sidecar and source manifest only; no tolerance

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the external acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. Verify vendor terms and clean integration before any distribution; keep source-reported scores labeled.
stable_fields.deliverable: Document the vendor boundary. Prototype an isolated adapter only if an approved public or user-supplied runtime is available. Reproduce the same-scorer DNSMOS-C comparison on 265 public vendor outputs if approved. Those outputs are locally scored, with no local vendor runtime or matched WER ensemble.
